snippet.title: [ＡＱＵＯＲ] Complete playthrough (+ Endings)
snippet.description:
So, enough procrastination! I've finally decided to get down with this, and record a full playthrough. I estimated this to take about 1 hour at most if I constantly got lost, but I found the way through all of them so it didn't take as long. In fact, it took halfway that much.

The game was created by koronba, and it's amazing.
Download it here: https://lcddem.fandom.com/wiki/Downloads
To boot up the game, copy one of the files in the CharSet folder and rename it to '乗り物.xyz' which should fix the issue.

Main background I used for this video (which I personally made):
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/324272524303007745/614680390971424768/deeper_sea.png

Background which I edited that was in the last segments of the video (which I edited):
https://cdn.discordapp.com/attachments/324272524303007745/614548621219856455/7th_1.png

Feel free to use them as you please!
